verdict.rationale: LM Studio is a local LLM runtime that serves models on OpenAI-like endpoints, so serving throughput is a fair axis. However, nothing in the evidence documents continuous batching, chunked prefill, or concurrent-request throughput optimizations. The server, headless llmster daemon, and llama.cpp/MLX backends are documented, but those are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can achieve high serving throughput via continuous batching and chunked prefill
